manifests.name: tabarena-confirmation-candidates-20260920
manifests.purpose: Six metadata-cleared, project-unexposed families locked before confirmation performance inspection. This is an audited subset, not eight invented approvals, forty cleared datasets, or official TabArena model reproduction.

exposure_audit.scope: Recorded project model execution only. Metadata inspection is not predictive exposure; public foundation-model pretraining and unrecorded external work are not certified absent.
exposure_audit.method: Compared all historical dataset identifiers and explicit real/synthetic source labels with origin aliases, source IDs and the existing family registry. Searched benchmark/package/example/test Python source for the six origin names and aliases; no pre-existing loaders/runs were found. No result scores or confirmation payload rows were inspected.

ledger_snapshot.query: SELECT family_id,run_id,role,created_at FROM exposure ORDER BY family_id,run_id
ledger_snapshot.execution_requirement: The runner must recheck its live RuntimeExposureLedger before any model run. This dated snapshot is not a bypass of later exposure.

preregistration.selection_basis: Primary-source rights, reviewed native target availability, recorded project non-exposure, source diversity and class feasibility; never predictive performance.

learner_search.policy: Matched training-only search spaces for raw and engineered methods; no outer-label selection. Existing runner middle-candidate selection estimators are fixed.

resource_amendment_before_execution.reason: Development-only evidence shows CatBoost predictive cells averaging about 155 seconds. Use a realistic 600-second cell ceiling and reserve 9.8 hours of the remaining measurement allowance for temporal/LLM work.
resource_amendment_before_execution.performance_inspection: No confirmation payloads, predictions or model scores have been inspected; cohort, methods, learners, seeds and search settings are unchanged.

preregistration.split_policy: All task-provided repeats/folds/sample IDs; no replacement by shuffled CV, no lite selection after results.
preregistration.expected_cells_formula: 6 families * 30 official splits * 2 methods * 4 learners * 1 estimator seed
preregistration.budget_note: 36 hours is a ceiling, not a completion prediction or authorization to consume other increments' budgets. 1440 cells at their full 600s timeout would exceed that ceiling; retain every unfinished cell in coverage and do not relax the cohort after inspecting performance.
preregistration.classification_margin_basis: Guard the nested selection/screening pipeline against tiny class fragments. Anneal's metadata minority class has only eight rows and fails this predeclared cohort margin; this is not a claim that every possible Anneal protocol is impossible.
preregistration.reporting: Family-level paired results, complete-pair coverage, failure/timeout denominator, worst-tail harm and uncertainty; binary ROC-AUC is secondary and not interchangeable with log loss.
restrictions: No further cohort/parameter selection from confirmation performance.
No claim of forty cleared families, unseen public pretraining, entity-disjoint or future-period generalization.
No paid/hosted LLM calls or transfer of source rows to model providers.
Before execution, the parent runner must bind this preregistration and freeze code/dependency fingerprints; the catalog does not silently enforce CLI model settings.
Failed acquisition/schema/class-support checks are retained as admission failures, not replaced with another family.

datasets.name: tabarena-46904
datasets.prediction_time: Specified frequency, attack angle, chord, free-stream velocity and suction-side boundary-layer thickness predict measured scaled sound pressure in a controlled physical wind-tunnel experiment. No response-derived predictor.
datasets.evaluation_notes: Curated attack-angle is nominal and is preserved as declared by OpenML, although UCI describes angle in degrees. Measured experiment, not domain simulation. IID operating-condition interpolation, not unseen airfoil geometry generalization.

rights.approval_basis: Original UCI publication explicitly licenses this dataset under CC BY 4.0; approved scope is local benchmark acquisition and aggregate reporting under the user's roadmap.
rights.obligations: Credit the UCI dataset and original NASA/Brooks et al. source; identify curated transformations. No hosted row sharing is approved.

exposure_audit.scope: Recorded project execution, not public model pretraining or unrecorded external work.

datasets.name: tabarena-46916
datasets.prediction_time: Cross-sectional classification of existing mobile-home-policy presence from other product holdings and postcode-level demographic summaries. No mobile-home-policy contribution/count predictor is present; target is removed. Not a claim about future policy purchases.
datasets.evaluation_notes: Primary UCI record explicitly lists TICTGTS2000.txt as publicly supplied evaluation targets. Curated training/evaluation merge has 9822 rows versus the UCI headline approximation of 9000; detailed original counts are 5822+4000. Minority count 586. About 15% duplicate profiles and shared postcode aggregates limit unseen-customer/area claims; official IID only.

rights.approval_basis: Original UCI publication explicitly licenses the dataset under CC BY 4.0 and identifies the released evaluation-target file. Approval is local benchmarking, not recovering hidden competition labels.
rights.obligations: Credit van der Putten/van Someren and Sentient Machine Research/UCI; disclose the curated merge. No row redistribution or hosted row sharing is part of this approval.

exposure_audit.scope: Recorded project execution; synthetic insurance_claims is not the real Sentient COIL customer data.

datasets.name: tabarena-46937
datasets.prediction_time: Driving scenario and respondent profile are presented before the survey answer about accepting a coupon. Predict the stated answer, not a realized purchase or actual coupon redemption.
datasets.evaluation_notes: Survey-scenario IID benchmark. No respondent identifier supports an entity-disjoint claim; repeated-respondent independence is not asserted. Curated constant-column removal, time parsing, categorical bins and typo fixes are retained. Minority count 5474.

rights.approval_basis: Original UCI publication explicitly grants CC BY 4.0, independently of the TabArena curator badge. Local benchmark scope only.
rights.obligations: Credit Wang et al. (2017) and UCI; disclose stated-preference and row-IID limitations. No hosted row sharing.

exposure_audit.scope: Recorded project execution, not public model pretraining or unrecorded external work.

datasets.name: tabarena-46954
datasets.prediction_time: Six molecular-structure descriptors predict experimentally measured acute fish toxicity. LC50 is already expressed as -LOG(mol/L) in the primary source; identity transform avoids a second logarithm.
datasets.evaluation_notes: Pinned curated task has 907 rows; UCI reports 908 chemicals. The one-row difference is recorded without inventing a cause or claiming exact source replication. Curator reports 15% duplicate descriptor vectors; no chemical-identity-disjoint claim. QSAR biodegradation is excluded from this cohort pending chemical-origin overlap review.

rights.approval_basis: Original UCI publication explicitly grants CC BY 4.0. Primary target/descriptor meanings, rather than only the curated badge, were reviewed.
rights.obligations: Credit Cassotti et al./UCI and describe the curated representation and existing log scale. No hosted row sharing.

exposure_audit.scope: Recorded project execution. QSAR biodegradation is not added as independent confirmation because chemical-origin overlap is unresolved.

datasets.name: tabarena-46958
datasets.prediction_time: Observed 60-position DNA sequence predicts exon/intron boundary type. The native instance identifier was removed upstream; only nucleotides remain as predictors, and SiteType is excluded.
datasets.evaluation_notes: Three classes, minority 767. Curation tabularizes the native DNA string, removes its instance ID and shuffles rows. IID sequence classification, not gene/species-disjoint biological generalization; all 60 predictors are categorical and numerical-only feature generators may retain raw features.

rights.approval_basis: Original UCI splice-junction publication explicitly grants CC BY 4.0. Original class/instance-name/sequence layout was reviewed against the curated features.
rights.obligations: Credit the UCI splice-junction dataset and its original contributors; disclose removed identifiers and IID scope. No hosted row sharing.

exposure_audit.scope: Recorded project execution, not public model pretraining or unrecorded external work.

datasets.name: tabarena-46969
datasets.prediction_time: Static permission-presence flags extracted from an application package predict its recorded malware label. No antivirus verdict, package identifier or target-derived field is a predictor.
datasets.evaluation_notes: UCI describes applications released in 2010-2019. The curated 7491-row task removes exact full-row duplicates from the much larger original dataset and changes its original perfect class balance; minority 2624. This is the pinned deduplicated retrospective task, not prospective malware-family/version-disjoint detection or untouched natural imbalance. All 86 predictors are categorical.

rights.approval_basis: Original UCI NATICUSdroid publication explicitly grants CC BY 4.0 for the tabular permission dataset. This does not authorize obtaining or executing malware binaries.
rights.obligations: Credit Mathur et al. (2021)/UCI; retain the exact curation and balance limitations. Tabular metadata/data only, no APKs, execution or hosted row sharing.
